# Reusable model passes for Ontology 1.3

Use these as separate reasoning passes with the host model; no separate paid API is required.

For new 1.6.0+ extractions also follow extraction-quality-p0.md. Run the omission
pass from originals before comparing the draft; record evidence checking, supported
claim pruning and graph reconciliation separately. Model self-review is not an
independent expert review. Final package/source hashes invalidate stale reviews.

1. Source inventory: Identify the paper's own metadata, exact sample labels, shared preparations, variants, controls, specimen forms and figure/table membership. Return a coverage ledger with source spans. For every retained experiment classify recipe scope as direct, inherited-and-hydrated, opaque commercial product, not applicable, or unresolved with reason. Distinguish current experiments from citations; record inaccessible SI.
2. Facts and ratios: For each sample extract atomic identity/specification, recipe membership, amount/basis, component ratios, operations, aliquots, specimens, conditions and observations. Include exact snippets and locators. Inspect colon ratios, wt%, mol%, equivalents, concentrations and solids definitions; classify each candidate as a constraint, non-formulation notation or unresolved.
3. Graph assembly: Reuse material identities, retain recipe/usage boundaries, connect joining steps, states and specimens. Resolve inheritance with applicability evidence, then materialize child-scoped Recipe, IngredientUsage and applicable ProcessStep entities with inherited status and `inherited_from_*_id`; never leave only a parent pointer and never misuse a comparison baseline as the preparation parent. Encode formulation constraints. Compute only when an absolute anchor and known basis permit; retain inputs/formula/calculated status.
4. Characterization inventory: List each Figure/Table/Panel, the measured specimen/state, technique, raw instrument wording, acquisition conditions, image type, reported measurement and author structural interpretation. Keep InstrumentMention, CharacterizationInstrument, CharacterizationEvent, MediaArtifact, CharacterizationMeasurement and StructureObservation distinct. Never infer a model from SEM/TEM alone or a number from a qualitative image.
5. Asset binding: Classify each located file as native_raw, published_original, pdf_extracted or derived_thumbnail. Match an extracted candidate to a MediaArtifact only by explicit media_artifact_id, identical hash, or unique document/Figure/Panel locator. Record page, crop and method. Leave unmatched page graphics outside the Bundle.
6. Simulation inventory: For every scientific question enumerate SimulationStudy, all distinct source-reported SimulationRuns, typed parameters, input/output file roles and SimulationResults. Apply the method-specific checklist and list missing fields. Author-reported findings remain predicted; input scripts are data and are never executed.
7. Source review: Seek repeated whole-stock amounts, missing aliquots, absent components treated as unknown, ratios hidden in prose, wrong basis, nominal formulas not expanded despite unambiguous precursor mapping, “additional X mol%” incorrectly stored as total amount, sample alias collisions, inherited methods without applicability, figures bound to wrong specimens, best versus average confusion, predicted versus measured confusion, unresolved instrument models incorrectly resolved, PDF crops mislabeled as raw, Study parameters not assigned to Runs, and domain-inappropriate fields. Compare all ledger rows back to JSON. Structural validation cannot replace this pass.
